interpretation: The final confirmatory model is deliberately simple relative to the effective event-level sample. Sophistication is demonstrated by broad mechanism search, pre-outcome feasibility/redundancy reduction, fixed regularization and a single distinct nonlinear challenger—not by maximizing parameter count.
prohibited_reframing: Do not claim all possible microstructure methods were tested.
Do not treat 12,752 trades as independent outcome observations.
Do not imply deferred Hawkes/HMM/deep methods would have rescued H2.
Do not use ART-030 ablations to redesign M_MOVE post-hoc.
